integrity: Analytical proof and rational full-state diagonal-generator checker included; 48 finite test instances corroborate but do not prove the all-size statement. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Result applies to the literal ordered-pair spin-exchange jump operators and rates of arXiv:2607.01452, Eq. 14, for finite networks and arbitrary initial density matrices. It concerns exact one-site expectations, not full-state mixing, covariances or quantum coherences. It does not exclude a different quantum generator with directed Friedkin–Johnsen first moments. Classical exclusion moment identities are established theory; the scoped model comparison is subject to residual unindexed-literature risk.
title: Exact symmetric-Laplacian opinion flow and a sharp no-go for the directed FJ reduction
